question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with an adverbial usage error.

Jackson told Aria, "Generally, I am grateful for your help."
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. "Generally, I am."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the** adverbial usage**, which is used to modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
 
• In this sentence, the placement of the adverb **"Generally"** is incorrect.
 
• The structure should place the adverb after the subject **"I"** and before the verb **"am"**.

Correct sentence: *"Jackson told Aria, "I am generally grateful for your help."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Placement of Adverbs:**

 
 
• Adverbs of frequency (e.g., always, never, often, generally) typically come after the subject and before the main verb.
 
• Example: She always arrives early.
 
• **Usage: **This positioning helps to clearly modify the intended verb.
